notes.note: Added a bullet for how a slotted check runs: the slot holder replaces the runner on macOS/Linux (execve), uses an owned Job on Windows, and runs as an ordinary child on Windows when no slot is held (hosted CI or a nested check). Checked against scripts/lib/slot-holder-exec.mjs (holdsSlot branch), scripts/heavy-check-slot.mjs (holdsSlot is true only for a fresh slot) and scripts/__tests__/slot-holder-exec.test.ts. path-read-pin-boundary.test.ts only classifies the slot suites temp queue reads.
Rechecked: verification-coordinator.test.ts only switches its file claim directory to trackTempDirs; the module map description of the verification coordinator is unaffected.
